## Recipes - List & Get

**Endpoint:** POST /webhook/recipes-list

**Actions:**
- `list`: List user's recipes (user_id, limit, offset, tags)
- `get`: Get recipe details (recipe_id)
- `delete`: Delete recipe (recipe_id)

**Pagination:** limit (default 20), offset (default 0)
**Filters:** tags (comma-separated)
